items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Freddy Mendelsohn calls you in 1974, and he tells you he wants you to do an album – another album for Savoy, Can’t We Begin Again?

ctx.x: Yes. That’s when he told Freddie to arrange the studio. I think that was in Linden, that studio.
Where you began to record. You knew of his recording label, Savoy.
